classification.difficultyReason: Read the period and a symmetry axis from the graph, reflect the supplied solution to obtain its partner, then translate both by one period and retain solutions within the domain.

inlines.text: Find the other solutions in the domain
using your knowledge of period and symmetry.

spec.description: Black arrowed axes without a grid; blue periodic curve with marked endpoints. Horizontal ticks every 3 are labelled through 24. Vertical ticks occur every 2, with only 4 and 8 labelled. No function rule is printed.
spec.mathematics: The curve has maxima (0,8), (12,8), (24,8), minima (6,-2), (18,-2), and period 12. It is reconstructed using y=5 cos(pi x/6)+3.
spec.answerVisibility: The complete supplied graph is visible in the question edition; the reconstruction equation remains unprinted.

answer.worked:
The period is $12$, and the trough at $x=6$ gives an axis of symmetry.
$$\begin{align*}6-1.77&=4.23\\6+4.23&=10.23\end{align*}$$
Add one period to each solution:
$$\begin{align*}1.77+12&=13.77\\10.23+12&=22.23\end{align*}$$
The other solutions in $[0,24]$ are $10.23$, $13.77$ and $22.23$.

Check on Desmos using $y=5\cos\left(\frac{\pi x}{6}\right)+3$ and $y=6$.
